method: Signed OpenAI response completion webhooks; no browser or laptop process is required after launch.
behavior: Review mode remains the default. Users explicitly choose background mode or enable it on an unfinished run.
Existing runs receive background_enabled=0 through an additive migration.
Raw-body HMAC verification includes delivery ID and timestamp with a five-minute tolerance.
D1 delivery receipts and workflow leases protect against duplicate steps and concurrent callbacks.
Only response IDs saved by SignalForge or its matching launch metadata can update an owned record.
Later steps receive prior findings and source links through the existing engine and quota checks.
Errors, partial results and allowance failures pause progression and require explicit review and retry.
Stopping a run prevents future steps; cancelling its current provider response is a separate action.
Chat and standalone report completions also synchronize while their pages are closed.
recovery: Non-successful webhook processing returns a retryable response. OpenAI retries failed deliveries for up to 72 hours. Manual workflow controls remain available if external delivery is unavailable.
rollback: Set BACKGROUND_WEBHOOK_ENABLED=false and deploy the saved version. Keep additive data and the webhook secret for completion synchronization. Background mode will not launch subsequent steps.
monitoring: This does not activate recurring monitoring. The existing paused monitoring automation is preserved; the public monitoring writer requires its own MONITOR_RUNNER_SECRET.
